scenes.vo: Leaves plug them up, so water has nowhere to go.
Think the rain flushes them out? Nope. Wet leaves pack down and freeze.

scenes.vo: Then water backs up under your shingles. That's an ice dam.
We clear every gutter by hand, flush the downspouts, and check your roof edge for free.
